desc:
🛎️ THE DITCH HOTEL 🛎️
Knock on doors. RUN. Don't get caught.

Every room in this hotel has someone inside, and they do NOT like being woken up. Knock on their door, sprint before it opens, and get paid for every door you ditch. Get caught and you're out!

🏡 NEW MAP: THE NEIGHBORHOOD - 32 houses, garden sheds to hide in, and an iron gate to escape through
🚨 FIRE ALARM knock - LIMITED for 7 days!
🤸 BACKFLIP KICK - boot the door and flip off it
🎧 NEW CHASER: Teenage Tyler

👵 Grandma, the Screaming Dad, the Sergeant, a dog... and worse
🎉 Party Houses pay x5 cash, but the WHOLE party chases you
🚪 Unlock crazy knocks: Sledgehammer, Flying Kick, Firecracker & more
🙈 Hide in lockers and sheds when they spot you
👥 Play with friends: Easy, Hard, Difficult, Impossible or Unlimited
🏆 Climb the Most Knocks & Most Escapes boards for a tag over your head

🎁 Join Jayqui Studios + like the game = FREE $10,000!
👍 Like & favorite for more updates!
